title: Chain Failure Recovery (gap fix)
brief: Define retry/partial-rollback/human-escalation chains for when automation fails mid-execution. Covers transient failure retry with backoff, partial rollback to last-known-good state, and human escalation with diagnostic context. Gap fix added during scrutiny.

units.title: Define retry chain: transient failure detection, exponential backoff with jitter, max-retry limits per chain type
Define partial-rollback chain: checkpoint state before each chain step, rollback to last-known-good on failure
Define human-escalation chain: diagnostic context packaging, escalation triggers, user notification with actionable info

exit_conditions: Retry chain handles transient failures with configurable backoff
Partial rollback restores last-known-good state on mid-chain failure
Human escalation packages diagnostic context for user action
All failure paths tested with simulated chain failures
